welcome: This guide follows seven tasks for a parent and fencer. We use fictional names and demo recordings.
enter-fencer: First, enter the fencer's name. Here, we use Alex Rivera.
continue-setup: Tap Continue to save the name. The app uses one fencer profile.
new-tournament: Tap the plus button to add a tournament.
tournament-name: Enter a tournament name. You can also set its date, location, and time zone.
save-tournament: Tap Save to create the tournament.
tournament-ready: The tournament is ready. Next, add its schedule or enter bouts yourself.
import-schedule: To use a schedule screenshot, tap Import Schedule.
open-screenshot-photos: Tap Select schedule screenshots. The app opens the Photos picker.
select-screenshot: Select the schedule screenshot. Make sure the names and table are clear.
add-screenshot: Tap Add to read the selected screenshot.
review-schedule: Scroll to the proposed bouts. Check opponents and bout numbers. Correct any mistakes before saving.
confirm-schedule: Tap Confirm Schedule when the details are correct. The app saves the confirmed bouts.
schedule-ready: The bout list now shows the imported schedule. The screenshot and proposed text stay on this device.
manual-open: You can also add a bout without a screenshot. Open Import Schedule again.
add-manual-bout: Tap Add proposed bout to create an empty row.
manual-opponent: Enter the opponent's name. We will use Casey Jordan.
manual-number: Enter the bout number from the full bout order. Use a positive number that does not conflict with another bout.
confirm-manual: Check the new row, then tap Confirm Schedule.
manual-ready: The manual bout now appears beside the imported bouts.
choose-bout: Before importing videos, open the correct bout. Every selected recording will go into this bout.
import-videos: Tap Import Recordings to open the recording review screen.
select-recordings: Tap Select Recordings to open the Photos picker.
select-video-one: Select the first recording from this bout.
select-video-two: Select any other recordings from the same bout. Several recordings can belong to one bout.
add-selected-videos: Tap Add to load the selected recordings.
allow-photos: If your device asks, tap Allow Full Access so the app can read the selected recordings.
review-video-import: Check the import results. If one recording fails, you can still confirm the successful recordings.
confirm-video-import: Confirm the import to attach these recordings to the bout. The original videos stay unchanged in Photos.
recordings-ready: The recordings are now linked to this bout. The app orders them by recording time.
open-editor: Tap Review and Trim Recordings to open the editor.
preview-original: Tap Play to preview the selected original recording.
pause-original: Pause near a moment that you want to keep.
show-trim-controls: Scroll to Trim a review clip. These controls set the section that you will save.
first-clip-start: Move the Start slider to the beginning of the useful action.
first-clip-end: Move the End slider to the end of that action. Check the selected duration.
save-first-clip: Tap Save Clip. The app creates a separate edited movie and queues its upload.
second-clip-start: To save another moment from the same recording, move Start to the next useful action.
second-clip-end: Move End to finish the second selection.
save-second-clip: Tap Save Clip again. One original recording can produce several independent review clips.
show-review-clips: Scroll to Review Clips. Wait for Available before clearing an uploaded clip's local copy.
favorite-first-clip: Tap the star beside a clip to mark that clip as a favorite.
clip-star-meaning: A filled star means this clip is a favorite. Tap it again to remove the favorite mark.
close-editor: Tap Done to return to the bout details.
bout-star-meaning: The bout's star is an indicator. It fills when at least one clip in that bout is a favorite.
open-clips-for-delete: To delete a review clip, open Review and Trim Recordings again.
find-clips-for-delete: Scroll toward the review clip list.
show-clips-for-delete: Find the edited clip that you want to remove. Check its start and end times.
delete-warning: Read the confirmation. Deleting removes the edited clip. It does not delete the original recording in Photos.
confirm-clip-delete: Tap Delete Clip to confirm. The app also removes the clip's cloud copy where applicable.
one-clip-remains: The other review clip remains. A cloud deletion that cannot finish immediately waits for recovery.
close-after-delete: Tap Done to return to the bout.
bout-no-favorite: We deleted the only favorite clip. The bout's star is now empty because no remaining clip is a favorite.
close-bout: Close the bout details to return to the tournament.
open-fencer-settings: Open Fencer to manage the profile and local clip storage.
storage-counters: Clip storage shows local exports and downloaded copies. These values describe device storage, not working memory.
clear-local-copies: Tap Clear Local Clip Copies to free storage on this device.
storage-warning: This clears uploaded local exports and downloaded copies across bouts. It keeps clips in iCloud and protects pending uploads.
confirm-clear-copies: Tap Clear Local Copies to confirm. The app reports how many files it removed.
storage-result: The local storage counts decrease. Saved cloud clips can download again when you play them with an available connection.
finish: Your original recordings remain in Photos. You can now organize bouts, save useful clips, and review them together.
